verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs list Apple MLX as an inference engine alongside llama.cpp, and the CLI exposes GPU offload control (--gpu=max|auto). A community user calls it one of the most efficient ways to run local LLMs on Apple Silicon now that it supports MLX. One brief hands-on test reported much slower speeds than Ollama on an M1 MacBook Air, which tempers confidence but does not concretely show the acceleration fails. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Metal GPU acceleration or native ARM builds, Apple Silicon performance benchmarks, and consistent independent corroboration of speedups.
